# Very Good Chocolate Sydney

> Small-batch, made-to-order cakes and private kids cake decorating classes for pre-arranged pick-up in Melrose Park, Sydney.

Official website: https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/
Cake catalogue: https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes
Kids classes: https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/classes
Customer reviews: https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/reviews
Sitemap: https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/sitemap.xml

## Ordering facts

- Orders are made to order and collected by pre-arranged pick-up in Melrose Park, Sydney.
- This is not a walk-in shop, and delivery is not offered.
- Submitting a request does not confirm an order. Jenny checks availability, sends payment details, and confirms the order after payment is received.
- Prices are in Australian dollars (AUD).

## Cakes

- Chocolate Pound Cake & Cupcakes: pound cake AUD 45 or one dozen cupcakes AUD 55. Finish choices may increase the price. https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/chocolate-pound-cake-and-cupcakes
- Pave Chocolate Cake: 6 inch, serves 8, AUD 75; 7.5 inch, serves 14, AUD 95; 9 inch, serves 22, AUD 115. https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/pave-chocolate-cake
- Chocolatier's Basque Cheesecake: classic AUD 55; pave chocolate on top +AUD 10 (AUD 65 total); Eiffel Tower finish +AUD 15 (AUD 70 total). One gluten-free 6 inch cake serving about 8. https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/chocolatiers-basque-cheesecake
- Lemon Cake: 6 pieces AUD 36; 8 pieces AUD 45; 12 pieces AUD 65; 16 pieces AUD 85. The 12-piece box is Most Popular. https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/lemon-cake
- Vanilla Fresh Cream Cake: 6 inch, serves 8, AUD 75; 7.5 inch, serves 14, AUD 98; 9 inch, serves 22, AUD 139. Choose vanilla or chocolate cake sheet and Triple berry or Nutella chocolate chip flavour. Product photo is coming soon. https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/vanilla-fresh-cream-cake

## Kids cake decorating classes

- Classes are private weekend sessions in Melrose Park, Sydney.
- Basic welcomes Kindy through Year 6, with Kindy–Year 2 and Year 3–6 groups.
- Advanced and Basic + Advanced packages are for Year 2 through Year 6.
- Current details and request flow: https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/classes
